mapper.insert: insert into t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn( warn_id, instance_id, warn_content, warn_time, warn_type )values( #{warnId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{instanceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{warnContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate(), #{warnType, jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.select: select a.instance_id as instanceId, a.instance_id_one as instanceIdOne, a.instance_id_two as instanceIdTwo, b.cruise_name as oneCruiseName, c.cruise_name as twoCruiseName, a.warn_threshold as warnThreshold, a.interval_type as intervalType, a.cruise_type as warnType, if (a.instance_id_one = #{deviceId},a.instance_id_two,a.instance_id_one) as oldId from t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance a left join t_cruise_point_instance b on b.instance_id = a.instance_id_one left join t_cruise_point_instance c on c.instance_id = a.instance_id_two where a.instance_id_one = #{deviceId} or a.instance_id_two = #{deviceId}

select c.task_id as taskId, a.cruise_id as inspectionId, a.result_num as resultValue from t_cruise_data_result a left join t_cruise_task_result_detail b on a.cruise_result_id = b.cruise_result_id left join t_cruise_task_result c on c.task_result_id = b.task_result_id where a.cruise_id = #{inspectionId} and a.createtime is not null and (select (a.result_num REGEXP '[^0-9.]'))=0
and a.createtime between #{startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
order by a.createtime desc
limit 4
